{{Quote|May Tooqui shrivel in the sun if he ever take a grain crumb from his new friends without asking. May his insides spill out on the ground and run run away like worm suckers. '''Worm suckers''' were animals found on [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] that ostensibly ate [[Worm/Legends|worms]], but which, given the nature of the creatures' native [[Gwurran]] describer, were perhaps the worms themselves.
